notes.title: 2025/08/28 Update
notes.content:
v2.3 Updated: Cursed Apostle

New Class: Hela the Soul Reaper
- The Abyssal Blade Wields: Redemption Through Destruction. Hela, the Soul Reaper, has been unleashed.

New Soul Core Series: Cthulhu Awakens
- Four new Cthulhu Soul Cores with two new affinities:
The King in Yellow + The Pope of Yellow Wind
The Highest Mother + The Sleeping Secret Daughter

New Treasure Hunt Gameplay
- Divine Demise
Inheritors can challenge Divine Demise solo, where Abyssal Overlord Modgud guards mysterious treasures.

New Soul Core: The Apostle of Silver Veils
- A new Physical-based, versatile Mythic Soul Core: ""The Apostle of Silver Veils"" is now available.
This Soul Core can equip a substitute Soul Core from the initial star level, inheriting part of its panel stat and second-slot passive skill.

New Soul Core Cultivation: Attunement
- The new Attunement Upgrade is now available for Soul Core cultivation, consuming Soul Core Fragment and Attunement Brightstone.

New Function: Skill Loadout
- Inheritors can apply recommended skill builds from the system or top players.

Cultivation
- Soul Core level cap increased to 150, advancement level cap expanded from 11 to 20, with no change in material costs.
- New Runes and Rune Whisper added.
- Optimized the strength of some Ice Soul Cores.
- New Mythic gear, Enchant items and new Immortal gear for exchange.

Gameplay Expansion
- Chapters Primglory 6-5 and Vortex of Origin 1-5 are now available.
- New Level 60 (60) Hero Co-op and Caravan Co-op dungeons added, featuring new gear, new Enchants, and more.
- Clearing the Vortex of Origin now grants new rewards: Soul Essence items.

Optimization
- Caravan: Added Caravan renaming and Leader transfer, and more Vice Leader slots.
- The screen will no longer turn off while the game is running.
- Added a ""Claim All"" feature for Daily Quest rewards.
...and various other improvements...

notes.title: 2025/07/03 Update
notes.content:
v2.2 Updated: The Dusky Bloodline

New Class - Chaos the Warrior
- This advanced class unlocks at level 25. ""Chaos the Warrior"" joins the battle wielding hammer-based, strike-focused weapons and skills.

New Game Mode - Astral Expedition
- Astral Expedition: A time-limited mode where Inheritors can form squads within their Caravan to challenge a brand-new boss — Darkvein Adiposer.

New Soul Core - Frozen Illusion of Divinity
- A brand-new Ice elemental, Soul Core “Balder The God of Light” is now available. It provides stable critical damage and solo Affinity, boosting all team attributes. The Supreme version drops exclusively from the time-limited Astral Expedition.
- Ice element Soul Core series is now fully added, including
“Loki The Evil,” “Cthylla The Frostwyrm,” “Kraken The Sea Monster,” and “Hydra The Deep Diver.”

New Cultivation - Myriad Casket
- Inheritors can now construct four Ancient affixes and preserve the exclusive affixes from the Mythic equipment, then ascend the Mythic equipment into Immortal Sets.

New Transmog - Crimson Curse of Immortality
- Character sets:
Hela “Crimson Moon Reverie,” Esther “Phantasmal Night's Allure,” Chaos “Lord of Eternal Night”
- Nephesh: “Nightmare Beast”
- Weapons: “Crimsonwing Blade,” “Phantomwing Pistol,” “Scythe of Judgment”

New Chapter - Fragments of Gladsheim
- Chapter Trurem 6-5 unlocks, World Progress, chapter task, Yggdrasil Blessing and more are available.

Optimizations - New Buds on the Yggdrasil
- A new ""Free Cast"" mode has been added; Inheritors can switch controlling modes in the Skill interface.
- A new ""Entity Illusion"" Willpower Leaderboard has been added; Inheritors can check their current Willpower rankings in the Thought Amulet interface.
- New ""Entity Illusion"" option button for sorting Solo/Co-op Silver Keys.
- New ""Entity Illusion"" feature: Skip battles and directly claim rewards from Solo keys tier 1 to 3 (no Privilege required).
- New Mythical Blueprint exchanges have been added to the Campaign Shop.
- Added a preview feature for the Thought Amulet, including estimated Willpower drops.
- Weekly and Monthly Pass daily rewards have been expanded — Inheritors can now choose additional rewards beyond the default ones.
- Improved display of Privileges in both leaderboard and chat interfaces.
- Optimized the main story boss challenges — after death, Inheritors can now use the “Spring of Revival” item to resurrect and continue the battle.
- Improved combat experience for certain class skills (including fixing abnormal skill range issues for Esther and adjusting the combat feel of some skills).
...and many other detailed improvements...

notes.title: V2.2 Update Announcemnet
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/14c8332f4693d250cff15ba2f08592d6e9641c76.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Inheritors:[/p][p][b]BOGX v2.2 update – The Dusky Bloodline: Astral Expedition will officially launch on June 11![/b][/p][p]This update features a [b]luxurious lineup[/b]: new game mode, new class, new Soul Cores, new Transmogs, and new cultivation systems...[/p][p][/p][p]The Old Ones whisper forbidden coordinates; the astral dust calls for an expedition [/p][p][b]Fully armed Inheritors...[/b][/p][p][b]Will you be able to traverse the stars and conquer the Old Gods?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]==== I. New Mode | Astral Expedition ====[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Upon returning from the Divine Trial in the Entity Illusion, the Inheritors are unexpectedly transported to a planet covered in a surface resembling muscular tissue — the sealed land of [b]Y'golonac’s Skull[/b].[/p][p]Here, a manifestation formed of black, viscous fluid is steadily corrupting the seal. To prevent the World Tree from being infected and parasitized, the Inheritors must defeat this entity and reseal it.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="pcNvTkz1ZLY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]✦✦✦ Gameplay Overview ✦✦✦[/b][/p][p]◇ Inheritors will form [b]3-player squads within their Caravan[/b] to challenge a [b]brand-new boss:[/b]
One of the Parasitic Old Ones, the Skin-Splitter of the Corrupted Star Core — the Embodiment of Y'golonac’s Skull: [b]Darkvein Adiposer[/b]
◇ Once the battle begins, [b]Darkvein Adiposer[/b] will periodically increase its [b]defense and attack[/b], either over time or when receiving a certain amount of damage. Be cautious of its complex and aggressive skills.[/p][p]◇ During the event, once a squad is formed, players [b]cannot team up with others outside that squad[/b].[/p][p]◇ Players can challenge [b]unlimited times[/b], and [b]only your highest score will be recorded[/b].[/p][p]◇ By completing the challenge, players can earn rich rewards, including [b]Squad Point[/b], [b]Caravan Points[/b], [b]Squad Rank[/b], [b]Caravan Rank[/b], and more.[/p][p]◇ See the full rules and rewards on the "[b]Astral Expedition[/b]" page within "[b]Caravan[/b]."[/p][p][/p][h3][b]==== II. New Control | Free Cast ====[/b][/h3][p]
Inheritors can now switch between [b]Free Cast Mode[/b] and [b]Skill Chain Mode[/b] from the top left corner of the [b]Skills[/b] page.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bc985a181e836c00b85b812e2aa4817b414c46c4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]◇ In [b]Free Cast Mode[/b], each skill enters its [b]own independent CD[/b] after being used, and is no longer affected by the shared cooldown of the skill chain.[/p][p]◇ However, in [b]Free Cast Mode[/b], the CD [b]of each skill may vary[/b], and the exact values can be viewed directly on the Skills page.[/p][p]◇ Certain affixes that enhance skill chains (e.g., “Increases damage while the skill chain is on CD”) may [b]partially or not function[/b] in [b]Free Cast Mode[/b]. For full compatibility details, refer to the "?" icon on the Skills page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]==== III. New Class | Chaos the Warrior ====[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Wielding a mighty warhammer to crush all evil, this formidable new class features numerous [b]super armor skills[/b] (with both[b] Ice and Fire elements[/b]) and can [b]enhance teammates' ATK[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/95b99bf5512945118ac920cf31a213dad6a7a50c.png"][/img][/p][p]An intrepid warrior born of noble lineage, Chaos is said to have held back the enemy, spilling his last drop of blood on the battlefield between humanity and the Fallen Gods to cover the retreat of the human allied forces. Hailing from the "Black Wolf" clan of the Human Royal City, Chaos descends from ancestors who once encountered Odin, the King of the Gods. From this union sprang offspring bearing divine blood, bestowing extraordinary power upon their descendants through their very veins.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]==== IV. New Soul Core | Frozen Illusion of Divinity ====[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]◇ New Ice Soul Core Now Available![/b][/p][previewyoutube="BORg1TN2sVs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]1. Loki The Evil (Mythic) & Frigg The Star Goddess (Primal)[/b][/p][p]After activating Affinity, you can manually refresh all skill CDs and gain high Crit rates and Ice Elemental ATK increases.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Cthylla The Frostwyrm (Primal) & Casias The Ancient King (Legendary)[/b][/p][p]Grants a significant final DMG bonus and DMG reduction. When triggering Cthylla's Active Soul Skill, it also reduces the target's Ice Resistance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Kraken The Sea Monster (Primal) & Grid The Black Coffin (Epic)[/b][/p][p]Provides a high Crit rate. When attacking enemies affected by Ice debuffs, deals increased DMG. Triggering the Kraken's active Soul Skill further boosts your Crit DMG significantly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Hydra The Deep Diver (Primal) & Isis The Diviner (Epic)[/b][/p][p]Increases great CD reduction. When facing monster crowds, the Deep Diver's Active Soul Skill also has a crowd-control (pulling) effect.[/p][p][/p][p][b]◇ Balder The God of Light[/b][/p][p]When Hel, Goddess of the Underworld, pronounced her oracle: "Only an ocean of mortal tears can redeem the Light," Balder's silver coffin was left suspended atop Yggdrasil. Prophecy foretells: When decayed roots sprout anew, he shall return, wielding an emerald branch and treading upon an ocean of cries.[/p][previewyoutube="VjovVCz_XfU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Affinity can be activated independently and grants a high boost to both Crit DMG and elemental DMG. Participate in [b]Astral Expedition [/b]to win the [b]Superme[/b] version by chance![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/26ed3c31aabb9c12fdc0f21c63d5aaedd3eae284.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/7dfbd9274d33541cb177bab1330acc8db9c640a4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]==== V. New Transmog | Crimson Curse of Immortality ====[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1b2a5fb430d8adc2b0d0f54a3677006dba289a42.png"][/img][b]Hela - Crimson Moon Reverie[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As the Blood Moon stains the withered branches of the World Tree, the blade entwines with the Eternal Night Rose.[/p][p]When she strikes down the starlight, her fangs and sword gleam in unison — a dual requiem of Norse valkyries and the progenitor of the bloodline.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/59bdb57186b9ad9a4250d6b5ccd5f03ef9386a3f.png"][/img][b]Esther - Phantasmal Night's Allure[/b][/p][p][/p][p]When the veil of night is torn by gunfire, starlight seeps through the gown.[/p][p]As she pulls the trigger, rose-tinted smoke and bloodline sorcery entwine—the bullet’s path curves like the vines of a Night Rose, blooming under moonlight with a deadly, graceful arc.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4d9299eb132037b82a3357b46e748b5881981ae9.png"][/img][b]Chaos - Lord of Eternal Night[/b][/p][p][/p][p]When the stars extinguish their final glimmer, the scythe carves through the veil of eternal night.[/p][p]With each swing, dark matter surges like a living cloak—every scythe dance tears open miniature black holes, as if the Abyss itself were wielding the power of harvest.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]==== VI. notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Advanced Cultivation - High Crit Based On Soul Cores & Gears
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bf2f7557d33db88c521fab3fcde31492229a0f18.png[/img]

[h1]Four Elemental Debuffs[/h1]

How do you release all four elemental debuffs effects to the enemies? It’s easy in co-op mode, each teammate has a weapon of a different element to cover all four. In solo mode, you’ll always trigger your primary-element debuff but still need the other three. 

You can rely on your armor’s ancient affix [when you cast a skill, having a chance to apply a random elemental debuff to the target], but it is too random, a more reliable way is to take different Soul Cores of each elemental debuff (using Soul Core Substitution function to preserve affinity completion), and then use their [b]Skill 1's elemental damage[/b] to apply the debuffs. Here are a few Soul Cores that are renowned for their strong sole capabilities:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/59594dcf9928ab5a48f0356cd1dee385c38b8833.png[/img]

[b]Fire: The Dragon of the End[/b] (Mythic) and [b]The Bombardment[/b] (Primal) both have the same skill 2 Extreme Blade, which boosts your ATK, making them incredibly versatile and easy to slot into almost any build.
[b]Ice: The Deep Diver[/b] (Primal) delivers massive CD reduction in the early stage, letting you cycle light-and-heavy-weapon skills easily. The Deep Diver will lose elemental-damage boost on Skill 2, but their other benefits are enough to make up for that trade-off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/85ac06734ca01f4dff2f7008155f7c82e5e44bec.png[/img]

[b]Thunder: The Allfather[/b] (Mythic) and [b]The Immortal[/b] (Primal), both “Odin” variants with broad applicability. The Allfather is the essensial for crit-based builds based on its third-skill’s huge critical-damage buff, while The Immortal gives you Extreme Blade on Skill 2 and a general elemental improves on Skill 3, so it very worthy to take.
[b]Poison:[/b] [b]The Monster Wolf[/b] (Mythic), [b]The Wise One[/b] (Primal), [b]Ymir Shell [/b](Primal), and [b]The Goddess of Youth[/b] (Mythic). Monster Wolf and Wise One both have Extreme Blade on Skill 2, Ymir Shell is essential for triggering crit, and Goddess of Youth offers sustained recovery, which is suitable for the early stage.

[b]Summary:[/b] Take The Dragon of the End, The Deep Diver, The Allfather, and Ymir Shell to reliably trigger all four elemental debuffs.

[h1]Other Soul Core Choices[/h1]

- [b]The God of the Moon. Lezard: [/b]As an essential Poisonous Soul Core, previous guide pointed out that Poisonous Core suffered from a lack of DMG reduced RES, but now with Lezard filling that gap。 I’ll revisit full Poisonous core recommendation in more detail later.
- [b]The Moderator & The Goddess of Fertility:[/b] Both received a enhancement to their Skill 1 damage, just be aware that their skill range is fairly small, so you’ll want to release them right next to your target for maximum effect.

[h1]Gears & Sets Suggestions [/h1]

[i][b]Abstract: Optional upgrade; not mandatory.[/b][/i]

[h2]“Chalky Sacred” Set[/h2]

This set is got from the [b]“Warrior Co-op: Cold Ice. Ancestor Shell” dungeon, Level 60(40)[/b]. 

Its four-piece bonus grants +15 % Critical Rate and +40 % Critical Damage; and, its base stats as same as the previous version’s Level 60 (10) Melted Iron Best-in-Slot gear, with the sole addition of 16 % All-elemental Damage Reduction. Consider the current version, pervasive damage overflow, this set is by no means a required upgrade. However, if you already possess three Mythic or Immortal gear with the “Set-1” affix, you may consider replacing the fourth piece with a [b]Chalky Sacred gear[/b] to secure the extra Crit Damage boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/022fd2d8a2e82f3995054ab9d71e8824d735a23b.jpg[/img]

[h2]“Blood Spirit Oath” Set[/h2]

[b]Got from the (Warrior Co-op – Thunderstorms. Skoll) dungeon, Level 60(40). [/b]

Its four-piece bonus grants +5 % Attack and +22 % All Elemantal DMG. Although this set sounds generally useful, now we already have [b]Twisted Meteor[/b] and [b]Abyssal Prism[/b], which increase higher sustain and DMG. The Nephesh slot is replaced by the Mythic [b]Thunder Spirit Fox[/b], offering extreme increasing skill-damage, and the skill level improve. So, the Blood Spirit Oath Set sees almost no use once those alternatives are available and is recommended only as a short-term choise for new players until they secure Best-in-Slot gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/0758a743731ecabeba79c96e11b1a7ab6ded0eff.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mythic Gear[/h2]

[i][b]Abstract: It is recommended to reroll weapon affixes to optimize their attributes.[/b][/i]

[b]Light and Heavy Weapons[/b]
- Compared to the previous version, the basic fixed affixes have received only marginal increases—insufficient to affect overall balance.

[b]However, this update introduces a new ancient affix which changed the game:[/b]

[b]Light Weapons (Best-in-Slot Affix Combination):[/b] Critical Damage increase, Critical Damage increase Against Debuffed Targets ,Light Weapon Skill Level Increase.
[b]Heavy Weapons (Best-in-Slot Affix Combination)[/b]: Critical Damage increase, Heavy Weapon Skill Level Increase, Attack or Elemental Damage increase.

[h2]Chaos Slot[/h2]

- In high-output scenarios, [b]Storm Heart[/b] outperforms [b]Twisted Meteor[/b].
- Although Twisted Meteor was the Best-in-Slot chaos in the previous version, based on its exceptional sustain. However, by the introduction of the [b]Talent—Fearless Warrior[/b] and unlocked cooldown-reduction attributes has greatly eased sustained concerns.
- So, [b]Storm Heart[/b] can be chosen as a transitional choice until you get higher-tier Immortal chaos.

[b]Immortal Gear[/b]

[i][b]Abstract: Strongly recommend to choose and rerolling the affixes.[/b][/i]

Chaos Slot – [b]Abyssal Prism[/b]
- Its permanent Critical Damage increase is very useful in the current version, where cooldown pressure is no longer an issue in the current version.
- For players with insufficient Critical Rate, its 18 % Critical Rate increase is also useful.
Recommended Affixes: Increases skill damage when releasing skills, Increases critical rate and critical damage upon entering combat” (new in this version).

[h1]Soul Core Build Recommendations for Each Elemental Style[/h1]

For detailed strategies, please read my previous guide. This summary follows the same foundation; the only adjustment is to choose new Soul Cores based on your current Crit Rate (e.g., have you over 100%?). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e8bb767d5df0efb2eb3b67d4dafb0e394958f6d4.png[/img]

[h2]Fire Soul Core Affinities[/h2]

Unlocking [b]Talent III[/b] greatly relaxes cooldown constraints on fire skills. By taking the [b]Solar Eclipse [/b]and [b]Divine Blaze[/b] affinity, you maximise your damage output, though these affinities need time to gradually stack its damage increase during combat and is not burst damage output.

- [b]Solar Eclipse:[/b] The Dragon of the End + The Sun Goddess
- [b]Divine Blaze:[/b] The Mortal Snake + The Bombardment
- [b]Judgment of Demonic Flame:[/b] The Lawvataine Creator + The Filthy Demon (equip The Filthy Demon in your soul core substitution)
- [b]Elegy of Nibelungen:[/b] The Solemn + The Dragonslayer (equip The Dragonslayer in soul core substitution; The Solemn serves as the reduction anchor and should at the front of skill combo)
- [b]Crossroads of Fate:[/b] Amorphous Eyes + The Tyrant

[h2]Substitution Affinities[/h2]

 Depending on your needs, you can add Substitution Affinities:
- [b]War of Gods[/b] (Final Damage increase)
- [b]Ancestral Frost[/b] (Attack Power increase; note that Fire’s Attack buffs may dilute this effect)

You may also choose any of these Soul Cores into your Soul Core substitution for sustain or Crit Damage increase. They all provide similar performances:
The Saint (sustain) / The Monster Wolf (sustain) / The Immortal (Crit increase) / The Wise One (sustain) / Audhum / The Warrior (sustain + Crit Damage)


[h2]Thunder Soul Core Affinity[/h2]

Thunder Soul Core has the highest damage ceiling among the four elements, but they rely on the Rune Whisper and requirement of Crit Rate.

- [b]War of the Gods:[/b] The Allfather + The God of Thunder (The God of Thunder as the core of Thunder RES Reduction, place at the front of your Skill Combo.)
- [b]A Knight’s Dream:[/b] The Goddess of Fertility + The Immoral Knight (After adjusted. The Goddess of Fertility can be equipped directly.)
- [b]Ancestral Frost:[/b] Ymir Shell + Ymir The Origin

[h2]Additional Support Affinities:[/h2]

- [b]Divine Blaze:[/b] The World Serpent + The Bombardment （High ATK increase）
- [b]Elegy of Nibelungen:[/b] The Solemn + The Dragonslayer （Gian high ATK after dodging）

[h2]Recommended Soul Core Substitutes:[/h2]

The Dragon of the End / The Dragonslayer / The Monster Wolf / The Wise One / The Bombardment / Audhum / The Warrior (sustain + Crit Damage)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e8bb767d5df0efb2eb3b67d4dafb0e394958f6d4.png[/img]

[h2]Poisonous Soul Core Affinity[/h2]

[b]Amorphous Havoc[/b] (The Amorphous Soul+The Wise One) Decent final DMG+huge Crit rate provides huge advantage in the early stage, also the soul skill of Hela can make a realm range to prevent flying attacks, which does amazing help in Caravan Co-op

[b]Crossroads of Fate:[/b] Amorphous Eyes + The Tyrant (proper enemy defense reduction+huge all-elemental buff)

[b]Soulbane Fenrir[/b] (The Monster Wolf+The Devil Lord) The passive skill of affinity is not impressive, but the sole Soul Core has good performance. The character will have a long invincible period when the active affinity is triggered, which helps the character who lacks that.

[b]Forbidden Fantasy[/b] (The Goddess of Youth+The Mistmon) Key output affinity, The Mistmon itself is not impressive, but The Goddess of Youth has a high recovery function, suggested to but it on the Break skill button. 

[b]Battle Soul of the Moon[/b] (The God of the Moon + The Warrior) Active affinity can trigger invincible with free movement, which is super useful in high difficulty dungeons. The God of the Moon itself is also a key one to reduce the enemy's resistance. Please put it in the front of the skill chain. The Warrior can support Hela's affinity, build a fast first stage of Crit hit.

[h2]Extra Affinity[/h2]

You may equip an extra affinity. Recommended options include the [b]Divine Blaze affinity[/b] (high ATK), [b]Elegy of Nibelungen[/b] (granting great ATK boosts after dodging), or the [b]Ancestral Forest[/b] affinity (which offers high basic attack, also the Ymir Shell is a Poisonous one already). Note that the existing [b]Amorphous Hela[/b] already contributes great Final Damage bonuses.

[b]Usually Poisonous Soul Core doesn't really need a substitute. The substitute affinity can be applied to the following strong sole Soul Core: [/b]

The Dragon of the End, The Bombardment, Audhum, The Immortal, The Dragonslayer

[h1]High Critcal ATK Style[/h1]

[h3]The Soul Core/Affinity you must have：[/h3]
Amorphous Havoc (Affinity), Ynir Shell, The Allfather, The Warrior

[h3]The Soul Core which reduces enemy resist[/h3]

The Solemn, The God of Thunder, The God of The Moon
Key Affinity (A Knight's Dream, Forbidden Fantasy, Judgment of Demonic Flame)
It is better to use the Thunder group if you want to hit on the highest Crit, here comes the perfect combination
Amorphous Eyes+Hydra (The Tyrant as the subsitution)
The Immoral Knight+The Goddess of Fertility 
The Allfather+The God of Thunder
Ymir Shell+Ymir The Origin
The Immortal, The Immoral Knight, The Goddess of Fertility can increase performance by being equipped on the substitute position of The Monster Wolf and Nidhogg

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/213e1ec06efb88efa8edc043e718d585eca67328.jpg[/img]

In order to provide players with a better gaming experience and improve the playability and interactivity of the game, [h3]we will launch the server update at 13:00PM, April 9th (UTC + 8), with an expected shutdown of 4 hours. [/h3]

After the shutdown update ends, Inheritors can receive [b]the following update reward through in-game emails:[/b]
[u]Orisol Contract *10
Soul Stone *588
Sanity Crystal *10[/u]

[b][h2]I. New Character Esther[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ac55b7ce56bbce88aa868080b8e5300039a662cc.png[/img]
Unlike Chaos and Hela, [b]Esther is a character with long-range offensive capabilities.[/b]
As a Valkyrie who wields firearms to deal damage from a distance, Esther offers a gameplay experience that emphasizes mobility and strategy.
The two newly unlocked classes for this character further diversify the play-style based on the foundation of her long-range combat template; providing a fresh and unique battle experience!

[h3][u][b]Basic Class [Hunter][/b][/u][/h3]
As a Valkyrie, Hunter Esther wields dual guns that can deal damage to large groups of targets, and after completing specific skills, she can perform a teleportation.
The Hunter primarily deals multi-segment physical damage to enemies.

[h3][b][u]Advanced Class [The Saint][/u][/b][/h3]
Esther is not only a noble and beautiful envoy but also a Valkyrie walking the mortal world. Therefore, based on this concept, Esther's golden armor, while maintaining its firm and solemn foundation, incorporates feather-like plates, which transform soft feathers into sharp protective weapons, further emphasizing her identity as a Valkyrie.
The Saint's heavy weapon is a handheld cannon, mainly inflicting Thunder, Fire, and minor physical damage, suitable for continuous area damage.

[b][h2]II. New Game Mode: Entity Illusion & Related Cultivation System[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5d565af60e71c4ff361d63410bb2880f937811ab.png[/img]
[h3][u][b]1.Gameplay Introduction[/b][/u][/h3]
Entity Illusion has 11 levels
Inheritors can use the Silver Key to enter a certain level while consume Sainty 
Chances to obtain 'Yellow Signs', 'Thought Amulets', and 'Silver Keys' of higher levels during the battle

[h3][u][b]2.New Attribute - Willpower[/b][/u][/h3]
Willpower is the exclusive attribute in Entity Illusion, to resist the mental corruption caused by unspeakable beings. It is said that when one's mental energy depletes, they will go mad and lose their sanity, ultimately becoming a sacrifice to Cthulhu
[h3]
[u][b]3.Items Introduction[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]✦ Silver Key ✦ [/b]
The treasure condensed from space-time energy at the heart of the World Tree, the Silver Key requires ‘Willpower’ as a prerequisite for use

The Silver Key is divided into 11 tiers, each capable of transporting the user to a corresponding level of Entity Illusion

The Silver Key comes in two types: single-player and multi-player. The multi-player Silver Key allows the holder to invite two other Inheritors to join the battle together, though the enemies within will also become more powerful

Each Silver Key has random affixes (either debuffs or buffs), Inheritors entering the illusion will be affected by these affixes.

----------------------------

[b]✦ Thought Amulet ✦ [/b]
The Blessing of the World Tree can protect iInheritor from the mental attacks of the unspeakable

The attributes of the Thought Amulet only take effect within Entity Illusion

The higher the quality of the Thought Amulet, the greater the Willpower and attribute bonuses it provides.

Thought Amulets are divided into four categories: Attack, Defense, Life, and Omni. Attack, Defense, and Life types can only be equipped in their corresponding slots, while the Omni one can be equipped in all slots

Thought Amulet can be disam into Amulet Fragments

----------------------------

[b]✦ Yellow Signs ✦ [/b]
An artifact imbued with the essence of Hastur grants the wearer terrifying power

The affixes attached to the Yellow Sign may potentially have negative values

The Yellow Sign can carry multiple same affixes

The higher the quality of the Yellow Sign, the more attribute affixes it can carry

[h3][u][b]4.Other[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]✦ Silver Key Extraction ✦ [/b]
The random buffs/debuffs of the Silver Key can be refined by using the ‘Yellow Sign’

There is a chance to get affixes which are from additional drops or add an extra affix by refining

Higher-quality Yellow Signs have a greater chance of refining affixes for additional drops and are less likely to transform these affixes into ordinary buffs/debuffs

The Silver Key can simultaneously carry the same additional drop affixes

----------------------------

[b]✦ Silver Key Infusion ✦ [/b]
The Silver Key can be refined using 'Amulet Fragments' obtained by dismantling the 'Thought Amulet.'
After refining, it can increase the drop quantity of certain items

----------------------------

[b]✦ Yellow Sign Synthesis ✦ [/b]
Yellow Signs can be synthesized in pairs
The synthesized Yellow Sign's quality will randomly fluctuate between the qualities of the two material Yellow Signs.
[i]For example,[/i] 
synthesizing an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue) with a Primal Yellow Sign (gold) may result in an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue), Epic Yellow Sign (purple), Legendary Yellow Sign (orange), or Primal Yellow Sign (gold). The attributes of the synthesized Yellow Sign will be randomly selected from the attributes of the two material Yellow Signs, with their values remaining unchanged.

[b][h2]III. New Level Released + Gameplay & Cultivation Expand[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bbdc08643be875c02af2bbaa62a8a6876830899e.jpg[/img]

10. New Talent Attributes III: Fearless Warrior

[h3][u][b]1. Fenrir The Monster Wolf 【Mythic】[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d22461a8efe93fbff84522b0c73349c83d36bccb.png[/img]

[b]Soul Skill 3:[/b] Fenrir's Blood - When releasing related skills and triggering active soul skills, Increase final damage

[u][b][b]Affinity [/b]- Soulbane Fenrir| Affinity Soul Cores: Chaos the Devil Lord[/b][/u]
[b]Lv1: Fenrir Claw[/b] - Poison Damage Increased.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/8a9ec989da8fac4b1e1fa741ca381b900fe34714.png[/img]

[i]Dear Inheritors,[/i]
The brand new game mode ——[u][i] [b]Entity Illusion[/b][/i][/u] will show up in the latest v2.1 update!
Today, we’ll share the real-time in-game PV, background story and gameplay features.
We’ll also be releasing more previews of the upcoming content soon, so stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=uPubdDtXcpA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]✦✦✦ Background Story ✦✦✦[/h3]
From the chaotic void emerge those unnameable Outer Gods, silently eroding our world. When tentacles pierce through slumbering R'lyeh's veil, the pallid sacrificial one awakens from the crimson prison. She offers her eyes, transmuting flesh into gem; forging the Silver Key, unlocking the Illusion gate.
Inheritors...
Only by confronting the nameless dread shall you reach salvation.

[h3] ✦✦✦ Gameplay Introduction ✦✦✦[/h3]
▶  Entity Illusion has 11 levels
▶  Inheritors can use the Silver Key to enter a certain level while consume Sainty
▶  Chances to obtain 'Yellow Signs,' 'Thought Amulets,' and 'Silver Keys' of higher levels during the battle
 
[h3]✦✦✦ New Attribute - Willpower ✦✦✦[/h3]
Willpower is the exclusive attribute in Entity Illusion to resist the mental corruption caused by unspeakable beings. It is said that when one's mental energy depletes, they will go mad and lose their sanity, ultimately becoming a sacrifice to Cthulhu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6a80cb3d58d8bf9aa56116602d222c43f5f98242.png[/img]

[h3] ✦✦✦ Items Introduction ✦✦✦[/h3]
[b]▶  Silver Key[/b]
✦The Silver Key requires 'Willpower' as a prerequisite for use
✦The Silver Key is divided into 11 tiers, each capable of transporting the user to a corresponding level of Entity Illusion
✦The Silver Key comes in two types: single-player and multi-player. The multi-player Silver Key allows the holder to invite two other Inheritors to join the battle together, though the enemies within will also become more powerful
✦Each Silver Key has random affixes (either debuffs or buffs). Inheritors entering the illusion will be affected by these affixes

[b]▶ Thought Amulet[/b]
✦The Blessing of the World Tree can protect Inheritor from the mental attacks of the unspeakable
The attributes of the Thought Amulet only take effect within Entity Illusion
✦The higher the quality of the Thought Amulet, the greater the Willpower and attribute bonuses it provides
✦Thought Amulets are divided into four categories: Attack, Defense, Life, and Omni
- Attack, Defense, and Life types can only be equipped in their corresponding slots
- The Omni one can be equipped in all slots
✦Thought Amulet can be disam into Amulet Fragments

[b]▶Yellow Signs[/b]
✦An artifact imbued with the essence of Hastur grants the wearer terrifying power
✦The affixes attached to the Yellow Sign may potentially have negative values
✦The Yellow Sign can carry multiple same affixes
✦The higher the quality of the Yellow Sign, the more attribute affixes it can carry

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/896f7ecbc19a9e36dfe06fc2ab2f0928ef987fe5.png[/img]

[h3] ✦✦✦ Others  ✦✦✦ [/h3]
[b]▶ Silver Key Remodel[/b]
✦The random buffs/debuffs of the Silver Key can be remodelled by using the ‘Yellow Sign.’
There is a chance to get affixes which are from additional drops or add an extra affix by remodelling
✦Higher-quality Yellow Sign have a greater chance of remodelling affixes for additional drops and are less likely to transform these affixes into ordinary buffs/debuffs
✦The Silver Key can simultaneously carry the same additional drop affixes

[b]▶ Silver Key Infusion[/b]
✦The Silver Key can be refined using 'Amulet Fragments' obtained by dismantling the 'Thought Amulet.'
✦After refining, it can increase the drop quantity of certain items

[b]▶Yellow Sign Synthesis[/b]
Yellow Signs can be synthesized in pairs
✦The synthesized Yellow Sign's quality will randomly fluctuate between the qualities of the two material Yellow Signs.
[i]——For example:[/i]
Synthesizing an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue) with a Primal Yellow Sign (gold) may result in an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue), Epic Yellow Sign (purple), Legendary Yellow Sign (orange), or Primal Yellow Sign (gold).

✦The attributes of the synthesized Yellow Sign will be randomly selected from the attributes of the two material Yellow Signs, with their values remaining unchanged.

notes.title: V2.1 Update Preview: New Poisonous Soul Cores
notes.content:
[i]Dear Inheritors,[/i]
The new v2.1 update for BOGX is coming soon!
[h3]The brand new powerful Poisonous Soul Cores would show up in the latest v2.1 update![/h3]
[b][u]【Hela The Amorphous Soul & Fenrir The Monster Wolf】[/u][/b]

[b]Today, we’ll share this two Poisonous Soul Cores' PV, background story and gameplay features.[/b]
We’ll also be releasing more previews of the upcoming content soon, so stay tuned!
[previewyoutube=R5MrJbnML1A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]==== 【Soul Core Story】 ====[/h2]
As a fragment of the self-will of Orlog, the "God of Dire," Hela is one of her many names.
Fenrir, on the other hand, is a guardian spirit born within the warrior Chaos, forged from the evil blood of the fallen gods and the holy power of Soulbane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/442556cbb0bcac1556d9e6d586b580c649295aeb.png[/img]
After the allied forces of the fallen gods led by the evil deities were utterly defeated, Hela and Chaos entered the hall of the All-Father, challenging the lofty gods.
Regrettably, the rebels' blades proved no match for the divine. Odin devoured Hela's soul with Soulbane, while Tyr severed Fenrir from Chaos's body and sealed them on Stone-South Island within the Red Black Lake...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3b911b973bbcdf328469fd954619e03094f80698.png[/img]

Trapped within the All-Father’s body, Hela wandered in despair, ceaselessly praying for escape from the Prison of Soul. Finally, her plea was answered by an entity known as the Amorphous Lord granted her rebirth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1d4739bd5dc114be925d0724aa00f90187771a42.png[/img]
Thus, Odin was cast into an endless cycle of torment,
while Hela the Amorphous Soul lurked within the god-king’s husk, awaiting the day of her reemergence. Meanwhile, Fenrir the Monster Wolf bided his time, poised to break free, resume his hunt for the Father of Gods, and seek his master once more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/869367e89fb578aeb261b84f57ec961d8aa35c01.png[/img]

[h2]====【Poisonous Soul Core Features】====[/h2]
✦ It can cause high-level continuous [b]poison damage to enemies.[/b]
Enemies that acquire the poison debuff status will suffer continuous poison damage per second. After the debuff bar is full, it can trigger Poisonous, enhancing the damage per second.
✦ It has the abilities of [b]recovery and defensive counter - attack, providing a more favorable output situation for Inheritors.[/b]

[i]For example,[/i] 
[u]'Hela The Amorphous Soul', [/u]can summon [Ethereal Field] to block flying objects, and 'the Goddess of Youth' can provide continuous life-recovery ability.
[u]The Affinity 'Lezard The God of The Moon' and 'Chaos the Warrior',[/u] can provide a high-level recovery and immunity to damage.
[u]The Affinity between 'Fenrir, the Monster Wolf' and 'Chaos the Devil Lord',[/u] can provide invincibility and damage reduction for Inheritors.

[h3]【Hela The Amorphous Soul】[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bede7e36ce18441a6b0d7f07a1db0739a45bc44c.png[/img]
[b][i]Poisonous/Ballistic interception/Pierce[/i][/b]
✦ Soul Skill:
During combat, Hela The Amorphous Soul will create an [Ethereal Field] for the Inheritors, inflicting potent Poison-attribute damage to enemies within the area. Additionally, it generates projectiles to obstruct enemies, creating opportunities for the Inheritors to engage in close-quarters combat.
✦ Affinity:
Hela The Amorphous Soul + Mimir the Wise One (Poisonous)
Increase the damage and attack speed of normal attacks, as well as boost the crit rate and pierce.

[h3]【Fenrir The Monster Wolf】[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d22461a8efe93fbff84522b0c73349c83d36bccb.png[/img]
[b][i]Poisonous/Heal Negation/SuperArmor[/i][/b]
✦ Soul Skill:
Meanwhile, Fenrir The Monster Wolf summons a phantom wolf for the Inheritors, which tears through enemies with Poison-attribute claw attacks. Notably, this damage cannot be healed, allowing the Inheritors to seize the initiative by dealing significant preemptive damage before closing in for melee strikes.
✦ Affinity:
[b]Fenrir The Monster Wolf + Chaos the Devil Lord
[/b]Enhances the poison damage along with providing damage reduction and invincibility effects.
After being attacked, increase the critical crit rate and all Elemental DMG Reductions.

notes.title: BOGX V2.1 Update : New Character Esther
notes.content:
Dear Inheritors，
[i]The new v2.1 update for BOGX is coming soon![/i]
[h1]The highly anticipated new character, Esther, will make her debut in this update [/h1]
Today, we’ll share Esther’s first in-game PV and background story.
We’ll also be releasing more previews of the upcoming content soon, so stay tuned! 
[previewyoutube=QOGbGQfizeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]【Character Story】[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bc2c8f23d8078ad29898755cd0008b48bea7758f.png[/img]
Raised under the tutelage of Aesir God, Esther embarked on a journey across the mortal realm with a divine mission as one of the best Valkyrie;
However, the sight of humanity suffering under the torment of fallen gods left an indelible mark on her heart.
[b]Ultimately, manipulated by the gods, she assassinated [Soulbane] Chaos, an act that plunged her into endless torment.[/b]
Summoned by the Dark Colossus, Esther was drawn into the void.
[b]As an Inheritor[/b], guided by Audhum, she now strives to restore the Colossus' Library, driven by a burning desire to redeem her past failure by dedicating to saving the world.

[h2][b]【Gameplay Features】[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/36ea10a653622871ccf12488df710037f75c159f.png[/img]
Unlike Chaos and Hela, Esther is a character[b] with long-range offensive capabilities.[/b]
As a Valkyrie who wields firearms to deal damage from a distance, Esther offers a gameplay experience that emphasizes mobility and strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3013a672eb99e13318f0cf045c0380d3b9cca790.png[/img]
The two newly unlocked classes for this character further diversify the play-style based on the foundation of her [b]long-range combat template, providing a fresh and unique battle experience![/b]

[h3][b]★Hunter★[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5a042093011642ab4ad13ff2b7b6bba6f9ae3d05.png[/img]
As a Valkyrie, Hunter Esther wields dual guns that can deal damage to large groups of targets, and after completing specific skills, she can perform a teleportation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4f47035848ef2b47afd6a25a75782f4493dae004.png[/img]
The wide - range normal attacks of dual pistols combined with the heavy - weapon shotguns are [b]suitable for players who love the exhilarating sense of action.[/b]

[h3][b]★The Saint★[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/92698cd1c0ebae333a3b72c2dc52ec4b227a93fb.png[/img]
Esther is not only a noble and beautiful envoy but also a Valkyrie walking the mortal world. Therefore, based on this concept, Esther's golden armor, while maintaining its firm and solemn foundation, incorporates feather-like plates, which transform soft feathers into sharp protective weapons, further emphasizing her identity as a Valkyrie.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5dc0af57296be19c8b19b890b87a1cf93488e6f9.png[/img]
The normal attacks of high - speed dual pistols combined with the powerful output of heavy - weapon 
heavy cannons are suitable [b]for players who like to control the battle rhythm.[/b]

notes.title: 2025/02/20 Update
notes.content:
Main Update Content:

1. Multi-Language Support (Preview)
Languages Supported: French, German, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian
(Updated on January 8th already, further optimizations would be added in version 2.0 on January 17th)

2. New Content
- Caravan Co-op Mode Available.
- New Bosses: Cold Ice. Amorphous Eyes, Poisonous. Alberich.
- New Soul Core Enchant Items: Soulmark.
- Soul Core Advance Item: Tear of the Divine.
- Soul Core Enchant Function Available: Attributes with percentage and random enchant affixes can be added to Soul Cores.
- Sub-Soul Core System Opened: Can now substitute the main Soul Core to participate in Affinity in Skill Chain.
- Added multiple new Transmogs/skins.

3. System/Gameplay Optimizations
- New Ancient Affixes: Required number of items in sets -1, more chance to be added when obtaining new Immortal gear.
- Increased and balanced the skill damage of Mythic and Primal Soul Cores.
- Balance adjustments for the skill damage of several characters.
- Optimized the difficulty of certain levels.

4. Bug Fixes and Other Optimizations
Reduced requirements for some quests, added new guidance tips, and fixed various bugs...
